requirement.section: 4. Shared contracts to complete / Resource broker
requirement.actual_path: Reader → Use voice for progress... → existing WindowsProgressSound worker → LocalProgressSpeech.speak_progress

observed_source_gap: The selected progress voice could be a heavy helper/model route, yet speak_progress called VoiceRegistry.synthesize directly. Its unconditional outer TemporaryDirectory cleanup and registry leave/run-lock release also ran after a causal AudioCleanupPending. This is a reviewed source boundary, not a measured CI failure.
changes: Reuse existing ReaderSynthesisRequest on the existing feedback worker. Known basic native routes retain their exact provider/type decision; heavy routes require the current library and share the existing ResourceBroker policy.

Pass the remaining original 30-second notification deadline as the admission timeout, with the same stop callback. SpeechSettings still limits each synthesis call to 20 seconds and 2 MiB, and notice text remains bounded to 240 readable characters.

Use existing retained_context(ExitStack) to retain the exact acquired run lock, active selected-registry reference and outer temporary audio until all causal native owners are quiet. Temporary cleanup executes before registry leave and serialization release.

Preserve existing uncertain playback player/temp retention, selection copying/close semantics, chosen voice/settings checks and false-on-explicit ordinary cancellation. Causal pending errors wrapped in InterruptedError or ResourceCancelled are re-raised for retained ownership.

Keep activation/copy/owner implementation and every helper after activate_progress_voice byte-identical. No UI, runtime, broker, provider, native-process, endpoint, policy, dependency or workflow source is changed.

Adapt only the existing test factory to an actual separate library policy and stable synthetic provider fingerprint. The post-synthesis cancellation test observes completed real PCM before cancelling, preserving its phase rather than relying on guard-call count.
Append 20 meaningful cases and one short user-help section; all previous case/negative-control assertions remain.

reuse.worker_thread_contract: WindowsProgressSound._start already calls speak_progress on carr-progress-sound. The new request is created on that same thread and uses a synchronous callback that reads saved settings and selected registry state only. No wx control reads or writes were introduced; existing timer/CallAfter integration is unchanged.

preservation.old_optional_installed_voice_dependency_: The two original optional Linux Flite availability checks remain unchanged. New cases have no skips; strict CI provides the actual required runtime.

added_case_groups.name: Actual shared CPU/RAM/output-volume reservation and release before playback
Exact basic provider remains available during competing heavy reservation
Unknown/heavy provider cannot invent a library policy
Real broker wait, explicit cancellation and original deadline including already-spent time
Saved settings revoked while waiting; verify runs on existing worker without GUI access
Actual pinned Python helper success/cancellation; exact existing owned launch exits before lease/files release
Two actual native child families; basic/heavy, direct/InterruptedError/ResourceCancelled and either exit order

causal_retention_assertions: Both real child families remain alive before release.
No final notification output or playback is accepted.
Outer/private stage, real broker reservation for heavy work, active registry ref and run lock remain retained.
A repeated notification is refused while ownership is unresolved.
Closing the last selection cannot close the registry before both families are quiet.
Completion acknowledgment is registered after retained-context callbacks and proves stage/lease/ref/lock release before final assertions.
Non-pending exceptional helper exit is recorded; causal pending exit is never credited as completed.

call_site_audit.result: No LocalProgressSpeech/custom registry construction; native progress uses notifications Off. Unchanged.
Injects the separate speak_progress/quiescent interface, not a VoiceRegistry. Unchanged.
Faithful current library root already supplied. Synthetic ListedVoices only selects/clones/closes; fingerprint begins only during actual speech. Unchanged.

review.fixture_correction: The actual helper observer now records completed non-pending exceptional exit and rethrows the same error. All assertions and53 planned cases remain.
review.cloud_readback: All3 core files fetched back in full and exactly matched prepared content.
review.inverse_checks: All3 full old preimages recovered exactly from inverse hunks.

qualification_limits: No host execution, test/compile run, native audio or CI result is claimed.
Actual test PCM/helper processes are synthetic fixtures, not neural inference or voice quality.
No consent/device/endpoint fallback, model installation, data upload or privacy/rights change.
Root owns all branch/ref/workflow integration; this package is an unreferenced sparse tree.
